metaTitle: BMW Trade & Fleet Engine Services | BMW Garage
metaDescription: Trade and fleet engine services for BMW vehicles – consistent quality, transparent quoting, technical support and fast turnaround. Rebuilds with full warranty for commercial customers.

sections.heading: What our trade and fleet service includes

blocks.html: We provide BMW engine rebuild and replacement services designed specifically for commercial customers. Whether you run a garage, manage a fleet, or trade vehicles, you need consistent quality, clear communication, and minimum downtime. Every rebuild we carry out for trade or fleet customers follows the same workshop standards as our private work — full strip-down, machining, reassembly, and road testing — backed by a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty that transfers to your end customer where applicable.

items: Fixed-price rebuilds with no hidden extras — you get a clear, itemised quote before work starts
Technical support for diagnosis, parts identification, and engine matching
Warranty that transfers to the final owner (subject to our standard terms)
Fast turnaround — we prioritise fleet vehicles to keep your revenue-generating assets on the road
Consistent, repeatable quality across multiple vehicles, using the same proven process every time
We work on all BMW models — from 1 Series to X7, including M-performance and M-cars

blocks.html: We offer competitive, transparent pricing for commercial customers. Because each engine and vehicle has its own requirements, we provide a tailored quote after inspection. Our standard rebuild starting prices give you a benchmark:

paras: **4-cylinder diesel** from £1,900  ·  **4-cylinder petrol** from £2,200 **6-cylinder diesel** from £2,800  ·  **6-cylinder petrol** from £3,200 **V8** from £4,500  ·  **Performance/M-Sport** from £5,500+
For trade-specific pricing and volume discounts, [contact our trade team](/contact).

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions about our trade and fleet services

items.q: Do you offer supply-only engines for trade customers?
items.a: No. We only provide rebuild and replacement services that include full fitting and testing. We do not supply bare engines or long-blocks for third-party installation.

items.q: Does your warranty transfer if I sell the vehicle on?
items.a: Yes — our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty is transferable to the new owner, subject to our standard terms. We'll provide the documentation to accompany the sale.

items.q: What is your typical turnaround time for a fleet vehicle?
items.a: We aim for 3-5 working days for a standard rebuild, but this depends on parts availability and the scope of work. We always prioritise fleet and trade work to minimise downtime.

items.q: Can you work on multiple vehicles at once?
items.a: Yes — we can handle multiple jobs in parallel. We have the workshop capacity and staffing to manage fleet-scale work. Get in touch to discuss your requirements.

items.q: Do you offer a discount for multiple engines?
items.a: We offer competitive pricing for volume work. Contact our trade team with your specific needs and we'll prepare a quotation tailored to your fleet.

items.q: Do you recover vehicles or engines?
items.a: Yes — we offer nationwide recovery from £70. We can collect the vehicle or the engine itself, depending on your preference.
